title: Called and set apart for the Gospel
english: [[Called as an apostle, set apart for the gospel of God >> Bible:Romans 1:1]]. Calling is not yet election — [[many are called, few are chosen >> Bible:Matthew 22:14]]. God separates for the gospel [[according to his purpose >> Bible:Romans 8:28]], not by chance.

title: Promised through the prophets; Son according to the flesh

title: Your faith announced; power and righteousness of God
english: [[Your faith is proclaimed in all the world >> Bible:Romans 1:8]]. [[I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God for salvation >> Bible:Romans 1:16]] — Jew first, then Greek. [[The righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith; the righteous shall live by faith >> Bible:Romans 1:17]].

title: Wrath from heaven; God handed them over
english: [[The wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness >> Bible:Romans 1:18]] of those who [[suppress the truth in unrighteousness >> Bible:Romans 1:18]]. [[Therefore God gave them up >> Bible:Romans 1:24-28]] to desire, dishonor, and a debased mind. Glory to Christ. Amen.
